rules.note: Upload the bio page of your personal ordinary passport. Colour scan of the original, not a phone photo.
Not listed in the official requirements.
Degree certificate with authentication: CSCSE for degrees from outside mainland China, CSSD for mainland degrees. If you have not graduated yet, an expected-graduation certificate can go in first.
Undergraduate transcript. If it does not show your overall GPA, also upload a separate GPA certificate from your university.
Transcripts of both your graduate and undergraduate studies. If a transcript does not show the overall GPA, also upload a separate GPA certificate from your university.
Personal statement, entered directly in the online application system.
A brief description of your research experience or research plan, uploaded with your application.
Two letters, from scholars at associate professor level or above, or from senior professionals in a related academic field.
Chinese (HSK) or English test score report, as set by your programme in the catalogue. Some schools waive it.
Nationality status documents, only if applicable (for example if you formerly held Chinese nationality). Some programmes also ask for extra documents; check your programme's remarks.
